## BLM — 2. Aprobación Showroom

Trigger: `N8N_WEBHOOK_DEALER_APPROVED` en Vercel
Webhook path: `blm/dealer-approved`

Payload esperado desde market (actions.ts):
`application_id, dealer_id, dealer_name, full_name, email,`
`temporary_password (null si usuario ya existía), login_url, dashboard_url, approved_at`

Requerido:
`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, RESEND_API_KEY, MAIL_FROM, ADMIN_EMAIL, SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL`
